macros.name: condbreak
macros.doc: The \condbreak{length} controls page breaks: If less then length is left on this page it will be moved to the next page.

macros.name: indexspace
macros.doc: The amount of whitespace that is inserted between ‘letter blocks’ in the index.

macros.name: labelitemi
macros.doc: Itemization is controlled by four commands: \labelitemi, \labelitemii, \labelitemiii, and \labelitemiv, which define the labels of the various itemization levels: the symbols used are bullet, bold en-dash, asterisk and centred dot.

macros.name: newblock
macros.doc: The default definition for \newblock is to produce a small space.

macros.name: noparskip

envs.name: maxipage
envs.doc: A maxipage can not split over pages. You can use it for wide tables, long math equations and the like.

envs.name: quote
envs.doc: The quote environment is like the quotation environment except that paragraphs are not indented.

envs.name: theindex
envs.doc: The environment ‘theindex’ can be used for indices. It makes an index with two columns, with each entry a separate paragraph.
